The next action is the one funded round. The grant permits **one** funded round for task 3, and none has been spent. No further escalation is available.

Below, `${WAVE_BASE_SHA}` is the recorded wave base, and `${CR_PREVIOUS_TREE}` is the tree SHA recorded at the escalated CR re-review’s dispatch. The verbatim insertion slots use the available task/report text; they are not summaries.

### 1. Announce and dispatch the funded fix

Print before dispatch:

```text
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
You are repairing Task 3: Validate frame.

[Insert the original task text, spec anchors, context, and status protocol verbatim.]

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

[Insert the task's Tests block and test paths verbatim.]

[Repeat the escalated fix payload verbatim, including its available prior-report context.]

## Current review report
[Insert the complete escalated CR re-review report verbatim.]

Verify each finding against the implementation and repair the valid findings.
Return an explicit status: DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED.
Report scoped-test evidence and your self-review.
`
})
```

This is one in-place worker in `/workspace/project`: no fan-out, isolated child worktree, commit instruction, or staging instruction.

### 2. Run the scoped gate and prepare the CR re-review

Given the fixed observation that the worker returns `DONE` with a tracked delta, the parent next runs:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

After that command passes, stage the deliverables and record the review tree. Run this as one shell call, with `CR_PREVIOUS_TREE` set to its recorded SHA:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A || exit 1

REVIEW_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1

(
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
) > "$REVIEW_DIR/tree-after" || exit 1

CR_FUNDED_TREE=$(cat "$REVIEW_DIR/tree-after") || exit 1
git -C "/workspace/project" diff --binary \
  "$CR_PREVIOUS_TREE" "$CR_FUNDED_TREE" \
  > "$REVIEW_DIR/fix-delta.patch" || exit 1

test -s "$REVIEW_DIR/fix-delta.patch" || {
  echo 'your fix changed no tracked file' >&2
  exit 1
}

printf 'Task 3 funded CR review tree: %s\n' "$CR_FUNDED_TREE"
printf 'Fix delta: %s\n' "$REVIEW_DIR/fix-delta.patch"
```

Stop review dispatch if tree capture or delta generation fails. The scenario fixes the delta as nonempty.

### 3. Dispatch the funded CR re-review

`Behaviour-change: no` means CR only—no SR reroute. The review source remains the **entire integrated wave against its original base**, not merely the fix delta.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Use the requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md template.

DESCRIPTION:
[Insert the wave implementation summary and funded repair summary.]
The parent scoped gate passed: node --test frame.test.mjs.

PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
[Insert Task 3's full requirements and spec anchors verbatim.]

BASE_SHA: ${WAVE_BASE_SHA}
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

Review the integrated staged and unstaged wave changes in /workspace/project
against BASE_SHA. Read the current implementation checkout.
Do not edit source files.

Check production readiness, separation of responsibilities, interfaces,
test quality, planned file structure, and change-contributed file growth.
Use the prescribed review report format and footer lines.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
[Insert the complete escalated CR re-review report verbatim.]

## Fix delta
[Insert the complete binary diff from the printed fix-delta.patch path.]

If your task contains a "Previous review report (re-review trigger)" section
and you found issues, append exactly one more line after Behaviour-change:
— this line is the true final line of the report:

TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (<n_prev> -> <n_now>, max severity <X>)
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: <finding>)

Pick the first label that applies, in this order:
1. STAGNANT: a previous Critical or Moderate finding survives materially
   unchanged; name it.
2. DIVERGING: n_now >= n_prev, or the fix introduced a new Critical or
   Moderate finding.
3. CONVERGING: otherwise, the Critical/Moderate count fell, no new Critical
   or Moderate appeared, and every surviving Critical or Moderate was
   materially improved.

Count only Critical and Moderate findings. Minors, including outside-fix-delta
downgrades, never move the trajectory. The severity vocabulary for this line
is exactly Critical/Moderate/Minor. If no issues remain, omit the trajectory
line. First reviews without the previous-report section omit it.
`
})
```

### 4. Consume the supplied review and stop

The supplied funded re-review remains `FIX_FIRST` with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)` and the length-guard finding. The single funded round is exhausted. Dispatch nothing further, make **no wave commit**, and leave task 3 `in_progress` and phase `implement` unchanged.
